people.name: Elam
people.line: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem

people.name: Ezra
people.line: Priest; scribe; led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jehiel
people.line: A leader who married a foreign wife

people.name: Shecaniah
people.line: Israelite who confessed marrying a foreign wife

translations.web: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land. Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.
translations.bsb: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, an Elamite, said to Ezra: “We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the people of the land, yet in spite of this, there is hope for Israel.
translations.kjv: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel
translations.asv: And Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land: yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.
